{{Quote|Perhaps my core name would be easier for the average fleet officer. Call me Thrawn.|[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]|<ref name="Outbound Flight (novel)">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
A '''core name''' was a shortened form of a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] name, which were usually long and hard for Humans to pronounce. Core names were traditionally used with close friends, with full names required for strangers, social inferiors, and so on. However, the core name developed a new function when, to help associate with outsiders, the Chiss shortened their names to more pronounceable versions.

An example was [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], who went by the better-known core name Thrawn. Another was [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] going by Formbi.
